description: Notarize an AI decision: bind (input, output, model) into a post-quantum-signed, Black-Box-chained, on-chain-anchored attestation with a re-verifiable permalink. Call to make an autonomous agent's decision auditable and non-repudiable (EU AI Act Art. 12 alignment). Proves the decision was sealed intact — NOT that it was correct. Price $0.05 USDC on Base.

agent_id.description: REQUIRED. Agent id (a 0x FRC-55 id is resolved on-chain; any label is bound as-is).

input.description: The context/input that produced the decision.

model.description: Model/agent version that produced the decision (bound as model_id).

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 X-PAYMENT (EIP-3009 exact-scheme payload, or {txHash}). x402-aware wallet clients pass this automatically via _meta["x402/payment"] — set it explicitly only if your client does not plumb _meta. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge.

name: notarize_decision
title: Notarize an AI decision (auditable, on-chain)
